mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 7.0% triggers a surge in investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods where UNRATE crosses below 7.0% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indicators signal robust economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window when both GDPC1 and INDPRO are rising, or returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, simultaneous declines in CPIAUCSL inflation and FEDFUNDS rates signal accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in late-cycle expansion periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite CPIAUCSL < 2.0 and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) reflects a strengthening labor market, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in periods of rising PAYEMS are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward surge in HOUST demand indicator above 600 units signals heightened consumer activity, fostering optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods where HOUST exceeds 600.0 are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous drop in UNRATE below 6.0% and rise in PAYEMS above 130,000 units signals labor market recovery, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 6.0% and PAYEMS rises above 130,000.0
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window when both UNRATE < 6.0% and PAYEMS > 130,000.0, or returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, rising FEDFUNDS rates and elevated CPIAUCSL inflation signal higher policy rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of FEDFUNDS > 1.5% and CPIAUCSL > 2.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).
